conventions.jaccard: mean over cases of |P and G| / |P or G|; an empty union scores 0
conventions.macro_f1: mean of per-label F1 over the whole label space; a label with no support and no prediction scores 0
conventions.per_label: precision is 0 when nothing is predicted for the label, recall is 0 when it has no support, so zero support and zero predictions gives 0 for all three; never_found lists labels with support and no true positive; labels are sorted by citation string
conventions.strata: same three scores per stratum, macro F1 over the whole label space; words are whitespace tokens of the joined sentences; an empty stratum scores 0
